title: Exterior Hail Review
description: Canonical form for exterior hail and wind file reviews.

canonical.title: Exterior Hail Review
canonical.description: Exterior hail and wind review focused on observed damage, roof and elevation documentation, and estimate consistency.

questions.text: Does the file document exterior damage observations by area or elevation?
questions.help_text: Review roof photos, elevation photos, inspection notes, and damage summaries.

questions.text: Is the estimate scope consistent with documented roof and exterior damage?

sub_questions.text: A documented exterior damage item is missing from the estimate.
sub_questions.help_text: Cite the damage photo or note and the absent estimate scope.

sub_questions.text: The estimate includes an exterior repair item not supported by the file evidence.
sub_questions.help_text: Cite the unsupported line item and explain the evidence gap.

questions.help_text: Compare documented damage to roof, gutter, siding, trim, and elevation line items.

questions.text: Were collateral indicators or lack of collateral indicators addressed where relevant?
questions.help_text: Consider photos and notes for gutters, soft metals, screens, fencing, and nearby surfaces.

canonical.outcome_justification: The canonical template includes a scope-consistency opportunity for exterior damage.
